messages.content: How would you respond to the following statement: If I do not have enough time to do everything, I do not worry about it.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: My worries do not overwhelm me.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I do not tend to worry about things.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: Many situations make me worry.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I know I should not worry about things, but I just cannot help it.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I am under pressure, I do not worry a lot.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I am always worrying about something.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I find it easy to dismiss worrisome thoughts.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: As soon as I finish one task, I start to worry about everything else I have to do.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I never worry about anything.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When there is nothing more I can do about a concern, I do not worry about it any more.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I have been a worrier all my life.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I notice that I have been worrying about things.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: Once I start worrying, I cannot stop.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I do not worry all the time.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I worry about projects until they are all done.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: Unforeseen events upset me greatly.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: It does not frustrate me when I don't have all the information I need.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: Uncertainty does not keep me from living a full life.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: One should always look ahead so as to avoid surprises.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: A small unforeseen event does not spoil everything for me.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When it's time to act, uncertainty paralyzes me.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I am uncertain I can still function well.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I always want to know what the future has in store for me.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I can stand being taken by surprise.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: The smallest doubt can stop me from acting.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I should be able to organize everything in advance.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I do not need to get away from all uncertain situations.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
